title: Business English Conversation 48:  Showing Around
content: 1. to take a tour of the office: to walk around and look at an office - Welcome to our office. Let's take a tour of the office and I can show you everything. - Mark, this is Carol's first day of work. Can you take her on a tour of the office and show her where everything is? 2. to show somebody around: to guide a person around a place and show them things of interest - My cousin is new to the city, so I will show him around this weekend. - Please show Jon around the office. He is new here. 3. to have a view of something: to be able to see something from a certain position - His office has a view of the city. - Our hotel room had a view of the ocean.
